The Trakstar Hire REST API (formerly Recruiterbox) enables developers to manage openings, candidates, candidate messages, internal notes, interviews, reviews, evaluations, and to-dos programmatically. It returns JSON responses and uses API key authentication generated from the account's Super Admin settings. The most common use cases include building custom career sites and syncing opening or candidate data with external systems.
